CLDR.description: Command Run Utility - Performance over Bloat

HMS.description: HHMS — Homeopathic Hospital Management System A LAN-based hospital management system purpose-built for homeopathic hospitals and clinics.  Runs entirely on the local network with a server-owned database — no internet dependency, no cloud lock-in.

Matneo.description: AI-powered digital products and automation platform.

NEO.description: NOVA — a statically-typed, compiled systems programming language: C, JavaScript, Rust and WebAssembly backends, with a runtime, package manager, language server and debugger.

Scrap-and-Gun.description: SCRAP & GUN — a retro pixel-art arena defense shooter with tactical construction, escalating enemy waves, persistent upgrades, roguelite drafts, bosses and local co-op. Playable in the browser, zero dependencies.

SmartNotes.description: Turn raw thoughts into organized action.

TTB.description: TinyToolBox with 590 functionalities in one small extension for chrome

The_Browser.description: Aetheris Browser — an experimental C++ browser engine with a dependency-free rendering foundation (Ladybird/SerenityOS-derived). Not production-ready.

ULTIMATE-WINDOWS-OPTIMIZER.description: OPTIMIZE DEBLOAT TWEAK TO THE LEVEL PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE ANY WINDOWS 10/11 INSTALLATION

aethelgard-games.description: Two free browser games by Dr. Sohil Momin — Aethelgard: The Books (visual novel) and Aethelgard: Chronicles of Fate (RPG). Playable on GitHub Pages.

aethelgard-rpg-engine.description: A dependency-free, vanilla-JavaScript engine for deep, single-player browser RPGs. Engine only — ships a small generic sample world; the games it powers live in drsamonline/aethelgard-games.

ai-bridge.description: VScode Extension to use webchat ais in vscoding environment

ambient-sound-studio.description: A private, offline ambient sound mixer that lives in a single HTML file. 25 synthesised layers, 36 presets, English/Hindi/Gujarati, WAV & Opus export, installable PWA. Free for personal use.

app-builder.description: Shared build kit: compiles a static web app into a single-file portable Windows EXE (PyInstaller) and an Android WebView APK (Gradle). Consumed by drsamonline app repos via a reusable GitHub Actions workflow.

app-clip-loom.description: Clip Loom — clipboard programs you can read: strip tracking, tidy text, keep what matters. Weft-8 on the Loom.

app-companion-forge.description: Forge tooling (not a product app): an offline pocket console for the Forge system.

app-encrypted-case-log.description: Per-patient clinical notes, encrypted on the device with AES-256-GCM. Offline, no account, no server. Built with Forge on crypto-kit, case-kit, search-kit, export-kit and web-kit. MIT.

app-image-toolkit.description: Compress, resize, convert and strip the GPS from photos on your device — nothing uploaded, no account, works offline. Built with web-kit + export-kit.

app-jacquard.description: Jacquard — the loom you program: a Weft-8 8-bit assembler and VM with the device's sensors as memory-mapped peripherals. Offline, single page, no accounts.

app-panchang.description: A daily Indian almanac — tithi, nakshatra, yoga, karana, rahu-kaal and muhurat, computed offline. Built with Forge.

app-poets-studio.description: Rhyme, metre and fixed forms, fully offline — a poetry workshop that measures what you wrote. 124,085 words bundled.

app-weft-puzzles.description: Weft Puzzles — small programming puzzles you solve in Weft-8 assembly, on the machine from Jacquard (the Loom).

art-kit.description: The art primitives Forge was missing: an indexed palette, a pixel canvas with nearest-neighbour scaling, draw ops, a delta undo stack, dithering (Bayer + Floyd-Steinberg), median-cut quantisation, sprite sheets, the isometric mapping and a sketch loop. Zero dependencies, single file, no assets. MIT.

astro-kit.description: The shared astronomy core for drsamonline apps: sun and moon longitude (Meeus), ayanamsa, sunrise/sunset, and tithi/nakshatra/yoga/karana. Zero dependencies. MIT.

audio-kit.description: Synthesis, theory, patterns and notation for offline apps: a pure ADSR envelope, oscillator voices, filters, noise and a mixer; notes, scales and chords; a pattern sequencer; a staff layout; byte sonification; and honest mastering helpers. Zero dependencies, single file, no audio assets — game music is patterns, not files. MIT.

audit.description: The change log for the drsamonline fleet: what was measured, what was fixed, and the evidence.

backup.description: Snapshot a repository BEFORE a merge replaces it: a reusable GitHub workflow + a zero-dependency script. Compressed, timestamped, rotated to keep the newest 100, and it rolls over to a new dumps repo when one fills up. MIT.

base-bench.description: Every number base, unit and timezone on one page, with the working shown. Offline, no accounts.

blinkcode-ai.description: BlinkCode AI — single-shot optical file transfer PWA (compression -> SpectraCode -> camera -> restore)

bmi-bmr-tdee-macros-fluid-calculator.description: Single-file clinical health calculator: BMI, BMR (Mifflin-St Jeor), TDEE, macros, fluid requirement and body composition, with Indian/WHO BMI cut-offs, saved entries, CSV export/import and EN/HI/GU UI. Offline-capable. By Dr. Sohil Momin.

boericke-repertory.description: Boericke's Repertory — a free, offline digital edition (single-file web app). Content by Oscar E. Boericke, M.D.; design & app by Dr. Sohil Momin. Free to use with compulsory attribution.

book-kit.description: The companion-app-from-a-book pattern: chapters, key points, practices, flashcards, search and reading progress. Zero dependencies, MIT.

canteen-lan.description: Order from your table over the room's own Wi-Fi - a LAN canteen board for Forge

case-kit.description: Clinical case tracking: sections, dated symptoms, follow-ups, a timeline and a summary. Zero dependencies, MIT.

chalk-lan.description: A shared whiteboard for the room: everyone on the same Wi-Fi draws on the same board, live. Offline, no accounts. Built with Forge on web-kit + lan-kit.

compfactory.description: Development workspace for CHCE multi-repo project

compress-kit.description: The shared compression core for drsamonline apps: gzip, deflate and deflate-raw via the platform's Compression Streams. One file, no dependencies. MIT.

conqueror-os.description: A private, offline resilience workspace in a single HTML file — read, reflect, journal, track and review. No server, no account, no dependencies.

control-panel.description: Every workflow in every repo: what runs, when, what calls what, and what is connected to nothing. The four stages from scratch to repair, the routes that need one input, and a Run button for each workflow. MIT.

crypto-kit.description: The shared crypto core for drsamonline apps: AES-256-GCM, PBKDF2 passphrase keys, sealed envelopes, one-time view. One file, Web Crypto. MIT.

dance-fight.description: A browser dance-fighting game where every fight move is a dance move. Load your own track and the character dances to its actual beat grid. Single HTML file, no dependencies, no build step.

dashboard.description: Live status of the drsamonline system: the repo fleet, build health, downloads and the store. Public so it can use free GitHub Pages.

drsamonline.description: Dr. Sohil Momin — homeopathic physician & builder of offline-first open-source software

drsamonline.github.io.description: Personal project index — a self-updating page that reads the GitHub API so new repositories appear automatically. Served at drsamonline.github.io

export-kit.description: Save text, JSON, CSV and binary to the user's device, and bundle files into a store-only ZIP. One file, no dependencies. Built with Forge.

frame-kit.description: The shared transfer-frame core for drsamonline apps: a self-describing frame, a rateless collector and byte/checksum utilities. One file, no dependencies. MIT.

game-kit.description: The shared game core for drsamonline apps: a fixed-timestep loop, input, scenes, save/load and maths. Zero dependencies. MIT.

gentle-pediatrics-companion.description: A triage-first home companion app for a sick child, built from the book Gentle Pediatrics by Dr. Sohil Momin. Free to use; copyright retained.

helioprism.description: One app, two optical transports — send a file with light over QR or a colour matrix. Offline, no network.

homoeopathic-materia-medica-repertory-js.description: Open-domain homoeopathic Materia Medica and Repertory texts as app-ready JSON (13 books, ~108k rubrics). Free to use; credit the book authors and the JSON compiler.

idle-city-ages-of-growth.description: A single-file idle city-builder that grows from a Stone Age village into a Fusion Age world-city. Zero dependencies, fully offline, mobile-ready. By Dr. Sohil Momin. Source-available: free for non-commercial use with attribution; commercial use requires a licence.

kent-repertory-explorer.description: Offline, single-file explorer for Kent's Repertory (1897) — 74,667 rubrics, 735,500 graded remedy links, case builder and grade-weighted repertorisation. No server, no backend.

lan-kit.description: The shared LAN core for drsamonline apps: a local room with a real-time channel over Server-Sent Events + POST. Zero dependencies. MIT.

lexora.description: LEXORA — Layered Exact-text Repository & Adaptive Compression Architecture

lockhtml.description: PIN-protect and one-time-view any HTML file with AES-256-GCM. Cross-platform CLI plus a browser-based GUI that runs on any OS.

ml-kit.description: The classic algorithms, from scratch, for offline features: tf-idf + cosine, Naive Bayes, k-NN, k-means, PCA, ID3, linear regression, Markov chains and a grammar expander. Zero dependencies, single file, no model, no API key, no network. MIT.

mnemosyne-companion.description: Companion study app for Mnemosyne Materia Medica — 100 polycrest homoeopathic remedies as poetic pearls, keynotes and spaced-repetition drills. Single offline HTML file. Proprietary, all rights reserved.

musicgen.description: A pocket generative composer — offline-first PWA that writes, synthesises, masters and exports music in the browser. No server, no samples.

neon-engine.description: A code-only open-world game engine for the browser. No assets, no build step, no dependencies — every texture, mesh and sound is generated at runtime. MIT licensed.

neon-games.description: Two free open-world browser games on the Neon Engine — Dead Zone (zombie survival) and Neon Police. Playable in the browser, no install. CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

neon-runner.description: Retro auto-fire side-scrolling shooter. Move, jump, duck — your gun fires itself. One self-contained HTML file, zero dependencies, fully offline.

neon-velocity.description: Procedural retro side-scrolling shooter for Godot 4.3 — zero binary assets, all sprites and audio generated at runtime.

offline-pdf-toolkit.description: Merge, split, rotate, reorder, watermark, number and compress PDFs entirely in your browser. No upload, no account, no server — works offline. Single self-contained HTML file.

open-materia-medica.description: Open Materia Medica — the classical homeopathic materia medica in plain language: 344 remedy portraits. Free web edition and offline Android companion app to the book by Dr. Sohil Momin, BHMS. (c) 2026, all rights reserved.

optical-kit.description: The shared optical-transfer core: a systematic LT fountain code, self-describing frames, and a pluggable codec. One file, no dependencies. MIT.

profile-kit.description: A small, reusable kit for a theme-aware, self-updating GitHub profile — hero banner, metrics card and README generator.

read-live-transform-app.description: The companion app to the book "Read. Live. Transform.: A Practical Reading of the Qur'an" by Dr Sohil Momin. Read the verse, live the practice, keep the change. Offline PWA, no dependencies. © Dr Sohil Momin — all rights reserved; permission required to reuse.

remedy-relationship-explorer.description: Offline, single-file explorer for homeopathic remedy relationships — built from public-domain materia medicas (Boericke 1927, Clarke 1900, Hering 1879). No server, no backend.

repertory-kit.description: The homeopathic repertorisation core: rubric grading and grade-weighted remedy scoring. Zero dependencies, MIT.

retro-strike.description: 🎮 A complete retro 3rd-person shooter in a single HTML file — custom software 3D renderer, chiptune audio, zero dependencies.

saga-vn-engine.description: Saga — a small, dependency-free visual-novel engine for the browser. Plain JavaScript, one stylesheet, no build step. Engine only; the games it powers live in drsamonline/aethelgard-games.

seance.description: Strongbox (master-list app) - sealed notes, opened once: seal a note with a passphrase, it opens once. Offline, no accounts. Built with crypto-kit + web-kit. (Fold-in of the working name 'seance'.)

search-kit.description: Ranked search over big corpora: an inverted index with prefix and fuzzy matching. Zero dependencies, MIT.

skills.description: Reusable, machine-consumable skills extracted from every drsamonline project — a categorised, self-updating catalogue with its own landing page.

skin-case-tracker.description: Companion app to the book "The Skin Is a Liar" by Dr. Sohil Momin — a private, offline HHMS skin-case tracker (History, Habits, Mapping, Symptoms) with a 90-day pattern engine. Free to use; all rights reserved.

smartbill-app.description: A fast, serverless, single-page billing and invoicing application built with Vue.js, tailored for Indian businesses. Features local IndexedDB storage and GST support.

srs-kit.description: Spaced repetition (SM-2) for flashcards: scheduling, lapses, due cards and stats. Zero dependencies, MIT.

the-symphony-companion.description: A pocket companion web app to The Symphony of the Present by Dr. Sohil Momin. Installable PWA, works offline. Copyrighted; free for personal, non-commercial use.

today-card.description: Today Card - one card for the day: your date, one intention, one task, and a streak. Offline, no accounts. Built with web-kit and Forge.

ui-kit.description: A reactive UI layer small enough for a single file: signals, computed, reactive effects, hyperscript, a keyed list, events, a hash router and form binding. Zero runtime dependencies, no build step. TodoMVC included as the acceptance test. MIT.

unstoppable-mind-companion.description: Offline companion app to the book The Unstoppable Mind by Dr. Sohil Momin - key points, exercises, a 7-day challenge and flashcards. Free to use.

web-kit.description: The shared offline-first runtime for drsamonline apps: storage, i18n (EN/HI/GU), CSV, PWA, theme, SEO, a11y. One file, no build step. MIT.

weft8-classroom.description: Weft-8 Classroom — a teacher's pack and exercises for teaching how a computer works, offline, one file.

weft8-compare.description: Weft-8 beside x86 and ARM — the same algorithm in three machines, so you can see which part is the computer.

weft8-hardware.description: Weft-8 on real silicon — a C port of the Loom's 8-bit machine, an Arduino/ESP32 sketch, and a parity harness.

weft8-kit.description: The Loom's Weft-8 as a reusable kit: an auditable, step-limited rule engine for other apps.

whispering-body-first-aid.description: Companion app for the book 'The Whispering Body' by Dr. Sohil Momin — a home homeopathic first-aid box (30 remedies). Free to use; source code and book content are copyrighted.

ziptastic.description: CHCE native engine — single binary, embedded codecs
